raw_output:
Giver: Right, we're starting at the telephone kiosk. Go up from there.
Follower: Okay, moving up from the kiosk.
Giver: Keep going until you hit the stone circle on your left.
Follower: Ah, there it is, the stone circle. I'll go left there.
Giver: Good. Now turn right and go up a bit more.
Follower: Turning right... going up.
Giver: Stop when you reach the bottom of that hill.
Follower: Okay, stopping there.
Giver: Now turn left. Head towards the stone circle again.
Follower: Left towards the circle? Okay.
Giver: No, don't go all the way back to it. Just go up until you pass it on your left.
Follower: Wait, I thought we were going towards it?
Giver: I said pass it on the left. Keep going up.
Follower: Ah, got it. Passing it on the left. Okay, heading up now.
Giver: Now turn right. Go towards the meadow.
Follower: Towards the meadow? Okay, turning right.
Giver: Don't go too far right. Just go until you hit the stile.
Follower: Wait, I see a stile over there, but I don't see one on my map.
Giver: Ah, did you draw that stile?
Follower: No, I didn't. I thought it was just a gate. Where is it?
Giver: It's a stile, not a gate. You're close to the wrong thing. Turn left now.
Follower: Okay, turning left.
Giver: Go until you reach the dead tree. That's the next landmark.
Follower: Okay, going for the dead tree.
Giver: Good. Now turn left again. Go up past the ruined monastery.
Follower: Wait, the monastery? I have a ruined monastery, but it's over here... and I don't have a dead tree.
Giver: Where's the dead tree?
Follower: I don't have one. Just a tree and a gate.
Giver: Ah, okay. If you don't have the dead tree, you've gone too far right. Turn left immediately.
Follower: Turning left now.
Giver: Go up past the monastery, then turn right. Head towards the great viewpoint.
Follower: Okay, past the monastery. Turning right.
Giver: Go up until you reach the viewpoint on the left.
Follower: Ah! Here's a viewpoint! But I thought there were only two viewpoints?
Giver: Yeah, there are two. This is the lower one. Go up from here.
Follower: Okay, going up from the lower viewpoint.
Giver: Keep going up until you hit the east lake.
Follower: Wait, I have an east lake up here... but I don't have a lower viewpoint. Where do I go?
Giver: You're at the wrong spot. Turn left. Go towards the bottom of the map.
Follower: Turning left. Okay, I think I'm near the start again.
Giver: No, don't go back to the start. You're just below the meadow. Turn right now.
Follower: Turning right. Going towards the meadow again?
Giver: No, go up from there. Head towards the ruined monastery.
Follower: Okay, heading for the monastery.
Giver: Pass it on the left. Go up.
Follower: Passing it on the left. Okay, going up.
Giver: Now turn right. Go towards the great viewpoint again.
Follower: Towards the viewpoint? But I'm already near it.
Giver: The upper viewpoint. This is the second one. Go up from here.
Follower: Ah, okay, the upper one. I see it now. Going up.
Giver: Keep going up until you hit the east lake.
Follower: Up... up... okay, I see the lake. But I also see a rocket launch pad. Is that near?
Giver: Ignore the rocket. Just go up to the lake. Stop there.
Follower: Okay, stopped at the lake.
Giver: Now turn left. Go towards the FINISH.
Follower: Turning left. Where is the finish?
Giver: It's just below the east lake. Look for the cross.
Follower: I don't see a cross near the lake.
Giver: Wait, check your map. Do you have a FINISH marked anywhere?
Follower: No, I just have start points and landmarks.
Giver: Ah, you missed it. The finish is right under the east lake on my map.
Follower: Okay, I'll mark a cross there.
Giver: Good. Now draw a line from the start to the finish.
Follower: Drawing the line.
Giver: Go via the stone circle, past the stile, up past the tree and monastery, to the viewpoints, then to the lake.
Follower: Okay, doing that. Stone circle... stile... tree... monastery... viewpoints... lake.
Giver: Make sure you turn at each landmark. Don't go straight through them.
Follower: Okay, turning at each one.
Giver: Stop when you hit the cross near the lake.
Follower: Okay, reached the cross.
Giver: Great. You're done.
Follower: Done.
Giver: Well done.
Follower: Thanks.
Giver: Bye.
Follower: Bye.
